احتجبت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَبْتُ (iḥtajabtu) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# اِحْتَجَبْتَ (iḥtajabta) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# اِحْتَجَبْتِ (iḥtajabti) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# اِحْتَجَبَتْ (iḥtajabat) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒa.bat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
